summary: Re-test of the Inbound STO Receipt feature after the iteration-130 fixes. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass (13 existing + 3 new lock/validation tests). CONFIRMED FIXED: (1) the PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH env fix genuinely works from the supervisor backend process - I REMOVED my iteration-130 symlink (/root/.cache/ms-playwright) before testing and a full live receive still succeeded end-to-end from the UI, so the browser is now resolved from backend/.env; (2) blank page was NOT a real bug - /inventory/inbound-receipts renders fully with 0 console errors, and the new catch-all route now redirects /inbound-receipts -> /; (3) qty max validation (inline inbound-receipt-qty-error-1 + Confirm disabled at 999 and at 0) plus server-side 400 before any job is created; (4) STO-level job lock returns the SAME job_id and creates no duplicate job; (5) progress-bar polling steps advance correctly and the dialog is fully non-closable while submitting (ESC + backdrop ignored, Cancel/Confirm/qty inputs disabled); (6) list wrapper is now overflow-x-auto and the Receive button is reachable/clickable at 768px and 390px. TWO REAL LIVE RECEIVES were run from the UI: STO-000026 (P1D1-463) and STO-000052 (3 deliveries, P9D1-4166/4165/4167). NEW HIGH-PRIORITY BUG FOUND on the multi-delivery run: after the FIRST delivery fails, every subsequent delivery in the same STO falsely fails with a raw Playwright timeout on the work-center nav - i.e. the nav fix only covers the success path, not the post-error recovery path. The quantity override could NOT be verified end-to-end (see below).

critical.issue: CASCADING FALSE FAILURES after the first failed delivery. Live run on STO-000052 (3 deliveries): P9D1-4166 failed with a genuine SAP message ('Valuation status for product 100002693-A1 at business residence P2 is not active' - expected), but then BOTH P9D1-4165 and P9D1-4167 failed with `Locator.click: Timeout 15000ms exceeded. Call log: waiting for locator("[aria-label=\"Inbound Delivery Notifications\"]")`. The error path only does `_click_button(page, 'Close')` before returning, which does not reliably bring SAP back to the work-center list (a discard/unsaved-changes confirmation or the still-open GR screen blocks navigation), so _open_inbound_delivery_notifications times out for every remaining delivery. Result: deliveries that were never even attempted are recorded as failed and the STO shows 'Receipt Failed'. Needs a hard reset between deliveries (e.g. page.goto the work-center URL / dismiss any modal, or re-login) instead of relying on 'Close'.

FALSE-SUCCESS path: when `_search_delivery` returns 0 hits the delivery is unconditionally reported {status:'received', note:'Already posted (not in Advised list)'} without any posting. Observed live on STO-000026 / P1D1-463 (was listed as pending, 2 EA): the job returned 'Already posted' in ~35s, the STO was persisted as receipt_status='received' and the UI toasted 'STO-000026 received as entered - closed in SAP.' even though NOTHING was posted and the 1-of-2 EA override was never applied. Any search miss (nav glitch, wrong list variant, site/personalisation filter, SAP slowness) is therefore silently converted into a successful receipt. Recommend verifying the delivery's real released/posted state via OData before accepting 'not in Advised list' as success, and at minimum distinguishing this outcome in the result/toast ('already posted in SAP - nothing to receive').

minor.issue: `await _set_line_actual_quantity(...)` return value is discarded. If the product row / Actual Quantity input isn't found the function returns False and the job silently posts the FULL Propose-Quantities amount while the UI reports 'received as entered'. Same class of silent-wrong-outcome bug as the old PATCH swallow - raise or record a per-line 'override_not_applied' flag.

The lock does `find_one({'sto_id': sto_id, 'status': 'running'})` on the SHARED `background_jobs` collection, which is also used by STO-CREATION jobs that carry the same `sto_id` field (verified: STO-000051 has a creation job doc with sto_id + status). A creation job stuck in status 'running' would make the receive endpoint return that unrelated job_id; the frontend would then poll it and treat its result (no `status` key) as a failed receipt. Add a job kind/type discriminator to the lock query.

minor.endpoint: error text surfaced to the user

Save failed

ui_bugs.issue: New ordering `e?.message || e?.response?.data?.detail` is inverted: for any axios HTTP error e.message is the generic 'Request failed with status code 400', which now permanently shadows the backend's `detail` (e.g. 'Received Qty for line 1 must be between 0 and the shipped quantity (1.0)'). Use `e?.response?.data?.detail || e?.message || fallback`. (The thrown polling Error is still surfaced correctly because it has no .response.)

Raw internal text is shown verbatim in the row: 'P9D1-4166: 2 Messages Message Strip Error Save failed ...' and 'P8D1-192: HTTP 500: {"error":{"code":"ERROR","message":...' (older rows). Truncated to one line with the full raw string only in the title tooltip - needs humanised copy.

'received as entered' fires even when the run short-circuited as 'Already posted (not in Advised list)' and therefore applied no override at all (observed on STO-000026). Toast should reflect the per-delivery notes returned in result.results.
STILL OPEN: unbounded while(true) with no max-attempt/deadline; a TTL-expired job doc (404) or a hung Playwright run leaves the dialog spinning until the user closes the tab.

integration_issues.flow: Confirm Receipt -> job -> poll -> toast -> refresh (single delivery)
integration_issues.issue: VERIFIED WORKING with the symlink removed (proves the backend/.env PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH fix): steps 'Starting...' -> 'Logging into SAP...' -> 'Posting Goods Receipt for P1D1-463 (1/1)...' -> dialog closes -> toast 'STO-000026 received as entered - closed in SAP.' -> list refreshes and the row disappears. Dialog non-closable while submitting confirmed (ESC + backdrop ignored, all controls disabled).

PARTIALLY WORKING: no hard timeout of the whole job and all 3 deliveries were iterated with correct progress text (1/3, 2/3, 3/3, ~40s each), but deliveries 2 and 3 failed only because the automation could not navigate back after delivery 1's SAP error (see backend critical #1). Frontend handled the failure result correctly (error toast + 'Receipt Failed' row).

NOT VERIFIABLE this round. The only two remaining pending STOs with a line qty > 1 were STO-000026 (short-circuited as 'Already posted', override never applied) and STO-000052 (all 3 deliveries failed). Please create/point to a fresh STO with a healthy product and qty >= 2 so the new grid-cell typing can be confirmed against SAP's posted document.

action_items: HIGH: make the Playwright automation recover after a FAILED delivery - deliveries 2..n of STO-000052 were falsely marked failed with a raw 'Locator.click: Timeout ... [aria-label="Inbound Delivery Notifications"]' because 'Close' does not restore the work-center list. Do a hard reset (navigate to the work-center URL / dismiss any modal, or re-login) before each delivery.

HIGH: stop treating 'delivery not found in the Advised list' as an unconditional success - verify the real posted state (OData) and label this outcome distinctly ('already posted, nothing to receive'); today a search miss silently marks the STO received and the toast claims 'received as entered'.

MEDIUM: honour the boolean returned by _set_line_actual_quantity - if the override cannot be typed, fail the delivery or flag override_not_applied instead of posting the full quantity and reporting success.

MEDIUM: fix the catch-block ordering in submitReceive to `e?.response?.data?.detail || e?.message || fallback` (the backend 400 detail is currently always hidden behind 'Request failed with status code 400').
MEDIUM: add a job-kind discriminator to the STO lock query - background_jobs is shared with STO-creation jobs that also carry sto_id.

LOW: humanise error strings (strip 'N Messages / Message Strip Error / Save failed' and never show Playwright exception text), bound pollReceiveJob with a deadline, darken the 'SAP Delivery Notif' sub-line.
Provide a fresh pending STO with a healthy product and line qty >= 2 so the reduced-quantity override can finally be confirmed end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: _post_one_delivery's two 'best-effort' shortcuts (0 search hits => received; ignored _set_line_actual_quantity result) both convert an automation failure into a reported business success - the highest-risk pattern in this feature.

Error strings returned by the Playwright layer are raw exception text and are persisted to the STO doc and rendered to end users; wrap all automation exceptions in a user-facing message and keep the technical detail in logs only.
The per-delivery loop has no isolation: a failure inside one delivery corrupts the browser state for the rest of the batch. Reset the page (or the whole context) between deliveries.
job_store's background_jobs collection is now used by at least two unrelated job types keyed on sto_id; add a `kind` field and index/filter on it.
STILL OPEN from iteration 130: server.py 6100+ lines, synchronous SAP backfill inside GET /pending, unbounded frontend polling loop.

rca_of_the_issue: 1) Cascade failures: _post_one_delivery's error branch returns after `_click_button(page,'Close')`; on a screen that just raised 'Save failed' SAP either keeps the GR screen open or shows a confirmation, so the side nav's 'Inbound Delivery Notifications' entry never becomes visible/clickable and _open_inbound_delivery_notifications' 15s click times out for every remaining delivery in the batch - those deliveries are recorded as failed although they were never attempted. 2) False success: the 'before_hits == 0 => already posted' assumption is only valid if the list view and search are guaranteed correct; on STO-000026 the run finished in ~35s (too fast for a real posting) with note 'Already posted (not in Advised list)', so the override was never typed yet the DB was set to received and the toast claimed 'received as entered'. 3) The blank-page report is confirmed NOT a bug: /inventory/inbound-receipts renders with 0 console errors and the new catch-all route redirects unknown paths to '/'.
